column1: # Breaking release: retired QueryBase/SequenceDedup/cache-only cases were removed;
# current graph recovery and snapshot/stream behavior remain required.

# the unused callback descriptor; native snapshot behavior is covered in the
# application bootstrap package and native_application_host integration tests.
